name: RunRequestThread
evidence: the request thread's loop: waits on g_requestSemaphore, takes the next entry of the ring and runs WakeThread, RotateReadyThreads or PauseThread on its argument, or prints the internal-error message

name: StartRequestThread
evidence: once (g_requestThreadId), creates g_requestSemaphore and the thread RunRequestThread on the stack D_00625770, sets its priority and starts it (InitKernelLibrary calls it)

name: QueueThreadRequest
evidence: original assembly: adds a request to the request thread's ring and signals its semaphore from an interrupt (QueueServerRequest and the memory card library's func_00209B10 call it)
